item.title: Stomach flu cases reported at Quinnipiac University
item.description: Quinnipiac University released health safety information after cases of viral gastroenteritis, or stomach flu, were reported among students, advising frequent handwashing, staying hydrated, and avoiding close contact with others when ill.

item.title: Gov. Ned Lamont extends severe cold weather protocol into mid-February
item.description: HARTFORD, Conn. (WTNH) — Gov. Ned Lamont announced Monday he's extending the state's active severe cold weather protocol for another week. The protocol will now remain in effect through at least noon on Tuesday, Feb. 10- making it the longest stretch of consecutive days it's been activated since 2015.
